scope: actual Qihe saves/storage/startup and engine in local VM; browser flow recorded separately
checks: enumerates all journeys and excludes unrelated/review saves
manual checkpoint copies complete progress without overwriting journeys
load saves current progress and forks an immutable checkpoint into a fresh journey
real engine restores the checkpoint scene and position
renaming active journey survives automatic save
invalid names and keys do not overwrite stored records
trash is recoverable and archived journeys do not appear on startup
damaged records are shown and retained without loading
storage failure keeps memory, target checkpoint and current record and blocks navigation
battle and running dialogue block write/navigation
all review contexts cannot create or alter formal journeys
home writes progress and returns to current launcher with no auto-play or review params
home shows startup and continuing reloads the last active journey
